title: The dsh fork pin carries every Tracy line at once: tracy.41 narrow frame, tracy.42 answer action row, the Thinking label and tracy.45 feedback categories
steps: S1: Read the pinned fork's sources (vendor/tracy/deepseek-harness): ui-chat chat/AnswerActions.tsx, chat-local.ts, chat/CommandNodeView.tsx, chat/MessageIconActions.module.css; ui-sidebar-right service.ts; ui-chat locale.ts; feedback/command-feedback index.ts; ui-commands locales.ts.
S3: Read the fork package.json version and test it against TRACY_DSH_RE in vendor/tracy/dsh-passwords/src/tracy/dsh-runtime.ts.
expect: S1: AnswerActions.tsx exists; chat-local.ts declares AnswerActions: ComponentType<LocalAnswerActionsProps>; CommandNodeView.tsx uses AnswerActions; the CSS names [data-chat-exchange]; service.ts declares readonly userGesture?: () => boolean; chat.deepDiving is 'Thinking'; command-feedback stores categories: [...entry.categories]; description.feedback is 'Help us to improve Tracy'.
S3: the version passes the gate and is -tracy.46 or later. On the old pin 1a87f60aba (tracy.45) six checks fail.
fence: Which fork commit TCH pins: a hotfix cut on an older tracy.N must not replace the integration line on develop.
